### 2026-10-26: I drafted a rough schematic on KiCad for my TFT screen. I don't really understand what I'm missing because there seems to be a few footprints missing and I'm still trying to figure out what they shoul

**2h**

I drafted a rough schematic on KiCad for my TFT screen. I don't really understand what I'm missing because there seems to be a few footprints missing and I'm still trying to figure out what they should be. I also don't know if I'm missing a part because in the tutorial there's a couple more parts than I have on my schematic. I kind of wish that we stuck to using github repos since they were a lot easier to follow along with. I'm probably going to join one of the help sessions to ask someone if what I did is correct.

### 2026-10-30: I added a few things to my schematic and finished up. I routed the pcb which took a while since the way things were connected was pretty hard to route (for me). The thing that took the longest was the

**4h**

I added a few things to my schematic and finished up. I routed the pcb which took a while since the way things were connected was pretty hard to route (for me). The thing that took the longest was the firmware. I used the tutorial code and adapted it to my own unique project. I used arduinoide for the firmware and I'm using the raspberry pi pico. This week was really hard for me because there wasn't a github repo/detailed images. I also updated the footprints in my schematic.
